items.title: Gang attack near Haiti capital leaves around 40 dead
items.description: Assailants attacked displaced people huddling inside a church in the Kenscoff neighborhood of Port-au-Prince on Sunday, killing some of them execution-style.

items.title: Haiti gangs kill more than 40 displaced people in church attack near capital
items.description: Gang members killed around 40 displaced people sheltering in a church near Haiti’s capital, a local mayor said on Monday. The victims were killed in an attack on Sunday night in Kenscoff, in the hills above Port-au-Prince, Mayor Massillon Jean said, describing a “night of terror”. Some people remained missing.
